compiled_state.title: Implement: approval-gate.md inferred-marker + severity bold rendering rules (1df2-5125 DD2+DD3)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Add two rendering rules to plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/approval-gate.md:
1. (DD2) Bold rendering rule for <<inferred:source-name>> markers, co-located inline with the ### Provenance Annotation Rendering section (before the Gate Template)
2. (DD3) Bold rendering for surviving assumption-category findings of severity high or critical in the ## Scenario Analysis block

## Why
Story 1df2-5125: The approval gate renders the epic spec for user review. <<inferred:...>> markers in the narrative must become bold so users see inferred source assumptions at the point of decision. High/critical assumption findings from red/blue team must also be bold to direct attention to the most impactful risks.

## Acceptance Criteria
- ### Provenance Annotation Rendering section in approval-gate.md contains a rule stating <<inferred:...>> markers render as bold text (e.g., strip the <<inferred:...>> tags and bold the enclosed noun phrase)
- The rule is within the existing Provenance Annotation Rendering section (not a new top-level section), placed before the Gate Template code block
- ## Scenario Analysis rendering instruction or the Gate Template notes that assumption-category findings of severity high or critical are displayed in bold (e.g., **[Finding text]** for high/critical)
- test_approval_gate_inferred_rendering tests go GREEN after this change
- No other approval-gate.md tests regress (test_annotation_summary_line etc.)

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/approval-gate.md

## testing_mode
GREEN
